changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'EnvironmentTemplate') begin create table [dbo].[EnvironmentTemplate]( [ID] [int] identity(1,1) NOT NULL, [EnvironmentLevel] [int] NOT NULL, [DatabaseServerID] [int] NULL, [DatabaseName] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [Notes] [nvarchar](500) NULL, constraint [PK_EnvironmentTemplate] primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) end
